title: Income tax report
body_markdown:
## Income Tax Report


Company share reports are available exclusively on the **[Digital Correspondence Portal.](https://correspondenciasdigitais.itau.com.br/login)**


[Click here](https://api.mziq.com/mzfilemanager/v2/d/6aa68515-2422-4cc4-bafa-8870ccdfedb0/5d1c8d76-0bba-9ec2-dd29-8e50a8f5a503?origin=2) * for the step-by-step guide to download the Income Report.


##


## Investor Service Channels at scriptureal


Custody Bank: Itaú Corretora de Valores S/A Capital Market Services Department.


Shareholder service is provided at the numbers below:


Held on weekdays from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm


3003.9285 (WhatsApp)
☎ 3003.9285 ( Capitals and Metropolitan Regions


)
☎ 0800.720.9285 ( Other locations


)


☎ 0800.720.5299 ( Exclusive telephone number for Income Report queries – available from 03/01 to 05/31)


Via e-mail through the Pre-Service channel: **PreAtendimentoEscritural@itau-unibanco.com.br** , where the customer is guided with instructions to follow the processes of:


- *Individual and Legal Entity Registration Update, Position Survey, Shareholder Evolution and Payment Statement – Individual, Individual and Corporate Income Reports.*


## For Itaú account holders, there is the option of consulting the shareholding position through Bankline, in the route below:


*Menu > Investments > Statement of Investments > Product > Shares booked by Itaú > Statement of movement > Fill in requested fields with period and custody Itaú*


*In addition, for shareholders with Android and IOS cell phones, the registration update via the Ion application is available, in the route below:*


*Access the ION app > Click on the upper right corner of the screen (profile) > Click on my account > Update your book-entry registration.*


(*) Information available in Portuguese only
